*   **Feedback Request (Unspecified Sender):** Feedback was sought from all stakeholders regarding the prototype's performance and user experience, with a submission deadline of the end of November.
*   **Additional Team Expansion (Rebecca):** To accommodate the project's scope, Mike Chen (machine learning) and Lisa Ray (cloud computing) were welcomed to the team.
